reviews.comment: This won't be easy if you do not know how to write essays, but if you do, it's a breeze. Be sure to read and complete the discussion posts every class day because it will definitely help you. Don't hesitate to ask her for help, either, because she's super helpful as long as you don't procrastinate. Loved her and her class!

If you can take anyone else that isn't Mary Evans, please do so. I went to her office hours for advice and she was very bland, almost as if she didn't want to be there. It is quite obvious she only is teaching courses because she has to for her program. Wish she was more passionate to improve and understand students who aren't good writers.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Homework readings every week with discussion posts. No textbook just novels and readings she will post online. Readings can be heavy at times. Tough grader I think. She is hilarious and makes the class fun, she's accessible outside of class. Evans is not for everybody but I think the class was great. Not an easy A for sure! You will put in work.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Prof Evans was a great teacher and had a very fun learning environment in her class. As an upper-level English course this class really was not that bad you just have homework over the readings and 2 big essays-5 page & 8 page. PLS listen to her essay feedback and submit drafts to her early on she will help you so much. i suck at english and got A-
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--So many papers

reviews.comment: Lectures were mostly unrelated to the assignment content. Evans only took attendance through emails. She gave no extensions beyond rare, extreme circumstances. She refused to post assignment and participation grades till the semester's end. The class is more akin to a book club than a real course. Cal 2 was easier
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Professor Evans is extremely passionate about what she does. The class is VERY reading heavy (if you like Sherlock Holmes this class is for you), and every grade you get in the class will be from a paper you'll write. She's tough, yet very fair with grading! Also easily accessible outside of class and is always willing to help!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Prof. Evans was very accessible outside of class and was always willing to help when I had questions! Rough drafts were required for each paper which was good because she could give feedback and then I knew what she was looking for. She has high expectations but is ready and willing to help; take her class if you like Sherlock Holmes!!

She's an extremely nice and fun professor who is passionate about what she does. While she does grade tough, she is always willing to give advice if you just email her. As long as you do this and put in the effort into your essays, you'll do well in the class. She made this course something different than typical english courses which was nice!

For the love of God DO NOT TAKE MARY EVANS. The lectures were absolutely pointless, she talked about TV shows the entire time. Not to mention the papers were graded EXTREMELY HARD. She would give 70's on papers and write "pretty solid paper" as the feedback. Engl 203 is supposed to be an easy class and she made it absolutely horrendous. DONT DO IT
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: English has never been my strongest subject but she made the class open to be able to write about anything that interests you and that helped me take interest in the course. It was tough to get an A and I started out with barely getting a B on the first paper. She does well to have many peer reviews. Pretty fun teacher, loves Sherlock Holmes
